Ruling: batch #161 item 5 · the code is wrong: `object-form.customFields` MERGES over the metadata-generated field set, as its published registration description says — the per-member merge branch in `ObjectForm.tsx` becomes reachable when `customFields` is non-empty; the registration description is unchanged · maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-09-18T12:07Z

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **代码错**; the maintainer agreed. Facts (this card; triage 5725870821): the registration description reads 「Field definitions merged over the set generated from object metadata」; the renderer replaces; the merge lookup `schema.customFields?.find((f) => f.name === name)` runs only when `hasInlineFields` is false, i.e. only on an empty `customFields` — dead code that records the intent; PR objectui#9774 pinned the current (replace) behaviour deliberately so any settlement re-reads it.

## Ruling

- `ObjectForm.tsx`: with a non-empty `customFields`, the metadata-generated set is rendered with each named member overridden by its `customFields` entry and unnamed members kept; a `customFields` entry naming a field absent from metadata is appended. The registration description stands as the contract.
- PR objectui#9774's member pin flips to the merge behaviour, with one case per direction (override, keep, append).
- Changeset `@object-ui/plugin-form` **minor** with a behaviour note: hosts that used `customFields` as a full replacement now see the metadata-generated members too; ⛔ no 「replace mode」 option is added (a host wanting a bespoke set declares its own form).
- ⛔ 散文错 would narrow the published author surface below what it promised, on a surface whose own code shows the wider intent.

Four-facet reading: ① the declared contract wins and the existing merge code shows it was the intent; ② 「override a few, keep the rest」 is the everyday use of a custom-fields hook; ③ an AI author reading the description gets what it expects; ④ nothing declared, an unreachable branch made reachable.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:spec`, `priority:p2` stay (lands in objectui's plugin-form). `Clause-②: no`.

Premise holds.
